screening_policy.numeric_similarity_disabled_reason: No criterion in the current compatibility matrix has been scientifically approved for numerical Earth-to-Moon or Earth-to-Mars comparison. Source definitions, physical quantities, temporal periods, spatial support, or reference provenance remain incomplete or incompatible.

compatibility_statuses.NUMERIC_ELIGIBLE: May contribute to a numerical score only after explicit site-specific approval.
compatibility_statuses.SCREENING_ONLY: May be used as a transparent filter/proxy; never as a numeric similarity score.
compatibility_statuses.QUALITATIVE_ONLY: Display source-backed descriptions without numeric comparison.
compatibility_statuses.EXCLUDED: Do not use as a matching criterion.
compatibility_statuses.NEEDS_VALIDATION: Keep out of numeric matching until definitions and scales are checked.

strict.southern_polar_aridity_policy: Include low-vegetation land cells south of 60 degrees south as aridity-unknown, not as dry.

extended.southern_polar_aridity_policy: Include low-vegetation land cells south of 60 degrees south as aridity-unknown, not as dry.

screening_policy.screening_interpretation: The aridity categories and vegetation thresholds are terrestrial screening proxies. They do not assert a standardized Martian aridity index, measured Martian NDVI, or validated analogue status.
not_used_as_independent_criteria: ssrd_wm2 and energie_kwh_m2_an are near-redundant representations and receive no scoring weights.
bare_pct is not Mars rock abundance.
Earth elevation is not compared with Mars elevation datum.
K-Means and DBSCAN cluster labels are contextual descriptors only.

lunar_context_source.frontend_use: User-filtered descriptive terrain, geology and surface context; no lunar similarity scoring.

output_notes: Similarity scores and feature contributions are intentionally empty.
The same Mars-wide terrestrial screen is repeated for Gale and Utopia; repeated candidates are not site-specific analogue findings.
Moon candidate CSV is intentionally empty because available criteria are not validated for numeric or site-specific screening.
Region cell-count order is not an analogue-suitability ranking.
Aridity missing at latitudes south of -60 degrees is marked unknown and is not interpreted as dry.
